name: Deutsche Cannabis AG
summary: Deutsche Cannabis AG engages in the acquisition, sale, and management of investments in cannabis industry primarily in Germany. It also focuses on the investment in the renewable energy sector, such as photovoltaics and cogeneration. The company was formerly known as F.A.M.E. AG and changed its name to Deutsche Cannabis AG in December 2014. Deutsche Cannabis AG was founded in 1999 and is based in Hamburg, Germany.
